source.title: Family Farm Adventure - Gameplay Walkthrough part 1 - Tutorial (iOS,Android)

core_loop: [seen] tap to clear debris/rocks from land
[seen] collect coins and resources from harvested plots
[inferred] use coins to unlock new land or buy tools
controls: [seen] tap on debris or rocks to initiate clearing
[seen] tap on empty soil to plant crops
[seen] tap on mature crops to harvest
[seen] tap on UI buttons (e.g., 'Skip' button for timers)
[seen] tap on character portraits or dialogue boxes to advance story
progression: [seen] currency counters: coins (1,183), green gems (20), blue gems (3)
[seen] level indicator: '39/41' visible in top bar
[seen] land expansion: cleared areas vs. rocky/unusable terrain
[seen] crop unlocking: sunflowers are planted; other crops may be unlocked later
[seen] building progression: small hut → larger structures as land clears
[seen] quest/story progression: dialogue triggers events (Flower Festival cancellation)
spec.session_feel: Paced with short-tap interactions and visual feedback; moderate screen density with animated characters and floating numbers; juice level medium (pop-up text, sparkle effects); estimated session length 5-15 min; target audience: casual mobile players seeking light narrative + farming loop.
